Archival Dispatch: 28 Master Broadcasts Dated Across Historic NFL Championships, Let's Pretend, Benny Goodman, and WWII Audio Journalism

Date: 2026-08-21
Author: radio index
Reading: 5 min
Tags: NFL Championship, The Greatest Game Ever Played, Johnny Unitas, Lets Pretend, Nila Mack, Benny Goodman, Peggy Lee, Martha Tilton, Edward R Murrow, Blitz, Original Filenames
Raw Markdown

Batch 57 Forensic Discoveries

Batch 57 resolves 28 legendary radio broadcasts spanning historic American sports championships, classic children's fantasy radio drama, the Golden Age of Swing, and live World War II battlefield and home front audio journalism: 8 championship broadcasts from professional football history (including Johnny Unitas' 1958 "Greatest Game Ever Played" sudden-death overtime, Vince Lombardi's 1962 Green Bay Packers title, the 1963 Bears championship, and the 1964 Browns shutout), 6 episodes of Nila Mack's Peabody-winning CBS series Let's Pretend (1944–1949), 6 broadcasts from Benny Goodman and His Orchestra (featuring vocalists Peggy Lee and Martha Tilton, 1936–1946), 6 historical wartime dispatches from WWII News (including Edward R. Murrow's legendary live RAF Lancaster bombing run over Berlin and Robin Duff's BBC London Blitz coverage), and 2 anthologized classic radio dramas from Escape and Family Theater.

1. Historic NFL Championship Game Live Radio Broadcasts (1958–1964)

The definitive radio coverage of foundational NFL title clashes:
